chatroom.title: Chat · TAP · Workpal
chatroom.body:
Chat
Archived
DEV · Search API rejects the new filter
DEV · TAP
The follow-up should establish which request shape each supported client uses, then decide whether to update the serializer alone or introduce a temporary compatibility adapter. Acceptance evidence to collect: running service commit, both request/response pairs, supported-client inventory and contract test results. The schema mismatch remains a hypothesis until the running instance is verified.
02:44 PM
UAT · Upload retry creates a second document
UAT · TAP
Agreed retest scope: retry the same upload session, deliberately start a new session, and upload different content with an identical filename. Identity should be checked using the session and content rules, not the filename alone. Before sign-off, attach the server timeline and demonstrate one document for a retry while preserving deliberate separate uploads. The release owner still needs to review that evidence; this conversation does not mark the acceptance case as passed.
03:44 PM
PRD · Knowledge search errors after deployment
PRD · TAP
Decision brief to prepare: • Confirmed impact window, affected paths and supporting request IDs. • Effective settings and revision for each serving instance. • Evidence linking the failures to the timeout/pool change, or evidence against that hypothesis. • Compatibility of the previous release with current data and dependencie
